canonical_project: Caritas-Krankenhaus Bad Mergentheim modular data center
owner: BBT-Gruppe / Caritas-Krankenhaus Bad Mergentheim; DC-Datacenter-Group general contractor
notes: Official district and hospital releases say construction started after groundbreaking in October 2025; 21 m x 7 m modular building with server room, electrical distribution, cooling, security, diesel backup, PV roof, expansion areas for AI; handover planned for Q1 2026; investment about EUR 3.6m.
